verdict.rationale: A live probe confirms that AssemblyAI serves an llms.txt at its root (HTTP 200), and a docs-level /docs/llms.txt exists. The vendor also publishes agent-oriented material: an agent-instructions.md that an AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md one-liner can refetch, with ?lang= and ?excludeSpec token-saving filters, plus a coding-agent-prompts page offering a docs MCP server and curated SDK context. missing for 10: a markdown docs index (/docs.md returns 404), independent community reports of agents using these docs

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: Add a one-liner to your AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, or .cursorrules so your agent refetches the latest integration prompt before every AssemblyAI prompt
Narrow with ?lang=python or ?lang=typescript to save tokens, or add ?excludeSpec=true to skip the API reference.
You want curated SDK-specific context (Python / JS / streaming / voice agents) bundled with the agent, auto-loaded when relevant.
